description: This file defines an Android Activity called WindowFocusObserver, which monitors window focus changes and updates UI text accordingly. It also sets up search and share actions in the options menu.

classes.name: WindowFocusObserver
classes.description: An Android Activity that observes window focus changes using a FocusObserver, manages search and share actions, and updates UI based on window focus events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and configures search and share actions.

methods.name: onSort
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling sort menu action (empty implementation).

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the search query text.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles the submission of a search query, showing a toast message.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Registers a focus observer to monitor window focus changes and updates the UI text accordingly.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Unregisters the focus observer when the activity's window is detached.
